model.description: Query Execution Stratification by Latency (All databases)
model.query_text: WITH q AS ( SELECT query, calls, mean_exec_time AS avg_ms, total_exec_time AS total_ms FROM pg_stat_statements ) SELECT CASE WHEN avg_ms < 1 THEN '1. Ultra-fast (< 1ms)' WHEN avg_ms < 10 THEN '2. Fast (1ms - 10ms)' WHEN avg_ms < 100 THEN '3. Moderate (10ms - 100ms)' WHEN avg_ms < 1000 THEN '4. Slow (100ms - 1s)' ELSE '5. Critical (> 1s)' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS total_queries, ROUND(SUM(calls)) AS total_executions, ROUND(AVG(avg_ms)::numeric, 2) AS avg_ms_per_bucket, ROUND(SUM(total_ms)::numeric, 2) AS total_impact_ms FROM q GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
